programme.title: Masters of the Zodiac
programme.sub-title: The Pink Racket & A Promising Flower
programme.desc: The cubs are playing badminton in the kindergarten. Herbert likes the pink racket. However, he overhears the others say the color pink is only for girls. So he does not dare to take the pink one, even though the one he uses is broken during the match. Then Old Billy joins them. The kids laugh at his floral shirt, but Old Billy doesn’t seem to care. Herbert understands he doesn’t need to pay too much attention to others’ opinions, and decides to use the pink racket.

programme.title: Masters of the Zodiac
programme.desc: The cubs are rehearsing a show. At first, Babu acts well in his role. However, he becomes nervous when Warren and Luna-Loo come to watch the rehearsal. He forgets his lines, and can’t act. Babu thinks he didn’t practice enough but Luna-Loo thinks he has stage fright. He gives his role to Ernie Jo. Then Babu’s dad helps him to overcome his stage fright, and asks him to imagine the audience as fruits. At last, Babu doesn’t feel nervous anymore and acts well in the show.

programme.title: Masters of the Zodiac
programme.sub-title: A Party at Violet’s & Got a Spare?
programme.desc: Violet invites her friends to her home, and has made proper arrangement. She thinks things will go smoothly. However, when her friends come to her house, they don’t want to follow her arrangements. They want to eat cakes and play with the ball. Violet doesn’t know what to do. Her father tells her that she should discuss with her friends about what to do. Violet listens to her friends’ opinions, and they all have fun.

programme.title: Origins Of The Twelve
programme.desc: The two watchmen land on earth and read out the royal edict to the Kitchen God. The Kitchen God takes over the edict with reverence and awe and follows them onto a mass of cloud heading for the Heaven. They look down at the village on the way and find the masses offering sacrifice to the Kitchen God, praying for happiness and good fortune.

programme.title: Origins Of The Twelve
programme.desc: After travelling miles of the sacred Heaven, the Kitchen God comes to the magnificent Hall of Miraculous Mist in the Golden-gated Cloud Palace. He poses a “V” (stands for victory) gesture with Aquila in front of the palace and asks Sonar to draw a portrait of them to mark the occasion. Shortly after, a lowly clerk comes over and brings the Kitchen God into the palace.

programme.title: Origins Of The Twelve
programme.desc: The Jade Emperor orders Aquila and Sonar to come down to earth and assist the Kitchen God with the task. Meanwhile, Rascal the rat finds the royal edict in the Kitchen God’s house and considers it a good opportunity to change the destinies of his family and himself. Rascal hides the edict to keep other animals from seeing it while the Kitchen God sees through his ruse and tries to recapture the edict. They get into an argument and start to scramble for the edict. Just then, Aquila and Sonar break into the house and join the scramble for the royal edict immediately. In the midst of chaos, the royal edict drops into a censer and is burned into ashes.

programme.title: Origins Of The Twelve
programme.desc: The Kitchen God, Rascal, and the two watchmen stand helplessly in front of the censer. Suddenly, a beam of golden light comes from the hearth and the royal edict floats up to the sky. The edict is made public and the news about the upcoming guardian tournament spreads like wildfire. The Kitchen God feels very remorseful for not keeping the secret. However, Aquila says that in that case they don’t need to worry about where to look for the competitors because all the masters will gather at Mount Tai from every corner of the village at that time.

programme.title: Pondemonium
programme.sub-title: A Whole New World & Bramble the Brave
programme.desc: Little Briar takes Vick’s axe and runs away with little Bramble. Vick follows them to the Pine Tree Kindergarten and meets many little animals there. Ms. Olivia tells him not to be afraid, and soon Vick gets along with the little animals there. Little Briar doesn’t want to join Vick and the other animals, seeming a bit lonely. Ms. Olivia then encourages little Briar to play with the others. At last, the kids at the kindergarten have a good time listening to Vick telling stories of the outside world.

programme.title: Pondemonium
programme.sub-title: Light Up, Little Guy & Happy Camping
programme.desc: The kids get in a cave of fireflies by chance, where they meet a firefly that can’t glow. They try to help it, but none of the methods work. Coach Mack tells them that a firefly takes in oxygen through air holes on its belly, and the more it takes in, the brighter the light it generates. By utilizing this principle, they encourage the little guy to light up at last.

programme.title: Pondemonium
programme.sub-title: A Bear’s Gotta Do What A Bear’s Gotta Do & The Watermelon Patch
programme.desc: Young Little Bramble is dependent on his brother doing everything, otherwise he’s gonna cry. Little Briar loves his little brother so he always makes a compromise. He takes him to school, lets him have the bigger apple, and win the game. In math class, Little Bramble is required to answer questions by himself. He fails and bursts into tears. After school, Little Bramble, who’s eager to catch up with Briar, walks home alone and works out math questions all by himself. Now he understands what his brother says, a bear’s gotta do what a bear’s gotta do.

programme.title: Pondemonium
programme.sub-title: Be Our Guest & Grow Bramble Grow!
programme.desc: Briar and Bramble invite Hoo Hoo to their lair. In order to treat their guest the best they can, they offer Hoo Hoo the best things they have, which turns out to be a great torture to Hoo Hoo instead. Hoo Hoo can’t stand it anymore and even finds herself unable to fly. Luckily, Mama Bear arrives home and saves her. She tells her sons --- Walk in others’ shoes, and then you’ll know what they really want. Then they provide Hoo Hoo with what she really needs, and have a wonderful dinner together.

programme.title: Pondemonium
programme.desc: Coach Mack teaches the kids not to open the door to strangers at class, and the next day, he disguises as a stranger to test the bear brothers. Mama bear cooperates with Coach Mack on the test and leaves home. Coach Mack tries various means to get the bear brothers to open the door, but to no avail. At last, the bear brothers pass the test.

programme.title: Origins Of The Twelve
programme.desc: On the way to Mount Tai, Rascal finds an excuse to run away but Feral Knight gets him back in no time. When they walk up to a dumpling shop, Feral Knight asks Rascal to buy some dumplings without giving him money. Rascal has no choice but to steal a package of dumplings. Just then, the dumpling shop owner finds him and shouts “stop thief”. Feral Knight rushes to the shop owner’s aid and takes the rat together with dumplings away. Feral Knight throws a dumpling to Rascal and eats up the rest of them.

programme.title: Origins Of The Twelve
programme.desc: Fierce the tiger admires the pupils in the Hands of Steel Academy and is simulating the movements in martial arts on the roof. However, he hits himself over the head with a broomstick by mistake and falls down from the rooftop. The master reads him a lecture and tells him to be a good cleaner. Despite the master’s instruction, Fierce never gives up his dream to become a martial artist. He is eager to prove himself a martial artist but is often more of a hindrance than a help.

programme.title: Origins Of The Twelve
programme.desc: Guardian the horse is galloping across the forest to look for the Hands of Steel Academy. He comes to the summit of a mountain and gets lost. Meanwhile, Fierce is having lunch in the forest. Guardian smells a wonderful aroma of steamed buns and walks into the forest to search for them. Suddenly two hedgehogs stand in the way and wants to rob him of some valuables. They run after Guardian at his heels and order him to stop.

programme.title: Origins Of The Twelve
programme.desc: The Kitchen God cannot drive the cloud teleporter and falls into the courtyard of the academy. He gets up and walks into the kitchen to check the hearth. At the same time, Fierce guides Guardian into the west wing room gingerly to show him Mazarine Jar, which however is discovered by the master. They are required to leave the Hands of Steel Academy at once. Guardian begs for the last dinner before leaving and the master agrees reluctantly. Then two animals enter the kitchen and make a fire to cook dinner.

programme.title: Boonie Cubs
programme.desc: The cubs break the trophy they won at the sports meeting. Fear of being criticized by Ms. Oliva, they make up a story that a blue bird attacks Briar and accidentally breaks the trophy. Ms. Olivia sees through their lie and gives them a lesson on honesty. The cubs confess their fault, and fix the trophy together.

programme.title: Boonie Cubs
programme.desc: Bramble decides to keep the caterpillar he finds on his head, and see how it grows up and becomes a butterfly. As time goes by, the caterpillar becomes a pupa, and soon it will turn into a butterfly. But in the process of metamorphosis, Bramble worries that it might get stuck, and tries to help. Ms. Olivia stops him and tells him that it needs to do it itself to get enough strength to fly. Just as they expected, the butterfly finally comes out, dries its wings, and flies.

programme.title: Boonie Cubs
programme.desc: The kids at Pine Tree Kindergarten are discussing what they want to be when they grow up. Vick says he wants to be an inventor and boasts that it’s easy to invent. To prove his point, he wants to invent something to dig holes as well as something for him to fly. However, both inventions meet with failure. Just when he is discouraged, he sees little Briar and Tiki playing paper planes. They are having a little contest. Then Vick gets an idea when he sees Bramble’s balloon. He attaches the balloon to the paper plane, and invents a “balloon plane” which could fly the most distance.

programme.title: Boonie Cubs
programme.desc: The cubs have got a new classmate – Ernie Jo, whose ears look different. A rumor starts that Ernie Jo’s big ears are infectious. Everybody tries to avoid him until Babu touches one of his ear by accident and he’s totally fine. The rumor is cleared and the cubs accept him. They invite Ernie Jo to play hide and seek. With the help of his big ears, Ernie Jo leads the cubs to find Little Vick who has fallen asleep and snores during the game. Now everybody wishes to have big ears like Ernie Jo’s do.

programme.title: Boonie Cubs
programme.sub-title: Rainy Day Fun & The More, The Better?
programme.desc: Violet hates rainy days. She doesn’t get why the others are having fun as usual. She tries to practice her flute, but rain drops cause her flute to get out of tune. Violet gets quite embarrassed and bursts into tears. To comfort her, everybody else gets busy doing funny tricks. Violet stops crying, asks why they enjoy the rain, and finds her own fun on rainy days.

programme.title: Masters of the Zodiac
programme.sub-title: Tiki’s Dancing Lesson & Mom and Me
programme.desc: Tiki admires Violet’s dancing. The kids all want Violet to teach them how to dance. Tiki goes to Violet’s home the next day. On his way there his friends tell him dancing is very difficult. He tries to learn some moves from Vick but he feel discouraged. He still continues to learn as Violet keeps encouraging him. But due to his nervousness, he steps on Luna-Loo many times while practicing. Luna-Loo tries to help him relax but none of the method works. Tiki dances in his own way and relaxes. He finally learns how to dance. He realizes he can’t just give up when others say it’s difficult.

As time goes by, the caterpillar becomes a pupa, and soon it will turn into a butterfly. But in the process of metamorphosis, Bramble worries that it might get stuck, and tries to help. Ms. Olivia stops him and tells him that it needs to do it itself to get enough strength to fly. Just as they expected, the butterfly finally comes out, dries its wings, and flies.

programme.title: Boonie Cubs
programme.desc: The kids at Pine Tree Kindergarten are discussing what they want to be when they grow up. Vick says he wants to be an inventor and boasts that it’s easy to invent. To prove his point, he wants to invent something to dig holes as well as something for him to fly. However, both inventions meet with failure. Just when he is discouraged, he sees little Briar and Tiki playing paper planes. They are having a little contest. Then Vick gets an idea when he sees Bramble’s balloon. He attaches the balloon to the paper plane, and invents a “balloon plane” which could fly the most distance.

programme.title: Boonie Cubs
programme.desc: The cubs have got a new classmate – Ernie Jo, whose ears look different. A rumor starts that Ernie Jo’s big ears are infectious. Everybody tries to avoid him until Babu touches one of his ear by accident and he’s totally fine. The rumor is cleared and the cubs accept him. They invite Ernie Jo to play hide and seek. With the help of his big ears, Ernie Jo leads the cubs to find Little Vick who has fallen asleep and snores during the game. Now everybody wishes to have big ears like Ernie Jo’s do.

programme.title: Boonie Cubs
programme.sub-title: Rainy Day Fun & The More, The Better?
programme.desc: Violet hates rainy days. She doesn’t get why the others are having fun as usual. She tries to practice her flute, but rain drops cause her flute to get out of tune. Violet gets quite embarrassed and bursts into tears. To comfort her, everybody else gets busy doing funny tricks. Violet stops crying, asks why they enjoy the rain, and finds her own fun on rainy days.

programme.title: Masters of the Zodiac
programme.sub-title: On the Same Page & Field Trip
programme.desc: Briar thinks Bramble is clumsy and can’t seem to cooperate with him well. The bear brothers have a match with Tiki and Babu. Tiki can eat the ice cream brought to him by Babu with his eyes closed, while Briar fails to eat the ice cream in Bramble’s hand. He feels even more frustrated when his face is smeared with ice cream. The cubs play a game after class. Briar still teams up with Bramble to get to the destination. However, Bramble falls behind. Briar chooses the path with apple trees at a junction in consideration of Bramble. When Bramble arrives at the junction, he thinks Briar would choose the bumpy path, and even sprains his ankles on the way. Luckily, Briar shows up just in time. They have a talk and finally understand that they love and know each other very well.

programme.title: Masters of the Zodiac
programme.sub-title: The Hazelnuts & All by My Luna-Loo Lonesome
programme.desc: Tiki, Ernie Jo, and Violet are playing ball in the forest. Tiki happens to find a hazelnut tree when going to pick up the football. He climbs onto the tree to pick the nuts. The trio decide to get these hazelnuts to Violet’s home so her mom can crack them open. Briar and Bramble pass by and help them with the task. When they remove the shells of the hazelnuts, however, the cubs fight to get more of the nuts for themselves. Violet’s mom suggests using the hazelnuts to make a cake, and teaches them to share things with their friends.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Todos sabemos que Pitufo Grunon odia varias cosas. Pero la cosa que odia mas que nada es el agua, cuando hay suficiente de esta para que se pueda ahogar. Veras, Pitufo Grunon no sabe nadar. Y cuando los Pitufos notan esta peculiaridad y le tratan de ensenar como sobrevivir en el agua, el malvado mago Gargamel hace que todo sea un poco mas peligroso de lo que deberia ser...

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La bruja Hogata promete a Gargamel un silbato magico si este le presenta al brujo de sus suenos. Sin embargo, ambos se enganan mutuamente con sus triquinuelas: Gargamel se disfraza de brujo, y el silbato magico de Hogata es simplemente un reclamo para aves.

programme.title: Los Pitufos

Tan solo algunos Pitufitos dan cierto credito a sus historias. Cuando muestra su verdadera naturaleza malvada, Papa Pitufo conjura un hechizo magico para salvar a sus pequenos Pitufos de las garras maliciosas del mago malvado.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado brujo Gargamel pide al mago Balthazar una receta para capturar a los pitufos. Implica secuestrar a la Madre Naturaleza para impedir la llegada de la Primavera. Por suerte, los pitufos salvan la situacion.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Es la primera Navidad de Pitufo Salvaje y esta impresionado por la decoracion de la Aldea Pitufa. Pero Abuelo Pitufo y Sasita van a ensenarle el autentico significado de la Navidad cuando ayudan a una pareja de ancianos a disfrutar de la Navidad mas hermosa que jamas hayan vivido...

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: La Primera Navidad De Bebe Pitufo
programme.desc: La ilusion de Navidad se ve frustrada cuando Chlorhydris hechiza a San Nicolas para que no pueda repartir felicidad en Navidad. Afortunadamente, Papa Pitufo y los demas pitufos consiguen romper el hechizo y devolver la Navidad a su bosque.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El Pitufo Carpintero se encuentra con una anciana trol en el bosque, que le suplica que le ayude a librarse de un grano rojo que tiene en la nariz... ¡dandole un buen puntapie! Pitufo Carpintero la ayuda sin mucho convencimiento. Y el resultado resulta sorprendente para el.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: No hay nada que la hechicera Clorhidris odie tanto como el amor en el mundo. Le gustaria que el amor desapareciera de la faz de la tierra y, para conseguirlo, ha decidido comenzar por la musica. Lanza un hechizo a un cuerno magico que absorbera la melodia de las canciones... en especial, de las canciones de los Pitufos. Con la ayuda de su amiga Laconia, es posible que los Pitufos consigan echar por tierra el malvado plan de Clorhidris...

programme.title: Simbolos De Sabiduria
programme.desc: Pitufo Filosofo esta desesperado por parecerse mas a Papa Pitufo. ¿Podria ser la respuesta un tonico capilar? ¿Conseguira Gargamel capturar por fin a los Pitufos? ¿Reside realmente la sabiduria en una barba?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos y Omnibus se hacen amigos de un desdichado joven cuyo maestro le obliga a robar. Pronto, el malvado ladron es entregado al magistrado y el joven esta encantado de irse a vivir con Omnibus.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Es la noche de los fantasmas y todos los Pitufos se preparan para la elegante fiesta de disfraces... pero Pitufo Filosofo se hace con el libro de magia de Papa Pitufo y todos los Pitufos se transforman en criaturas horrendas, aunque divertidas. No obstante, el peligro acecha...

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La produccion teatral de los Pitufos "Pitufo Robin" se convierte en realidad con un actor real del legendario heroe.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Un duende maligno le pone unos zapatos magicos a Pitufina, que no puede dejar de bailar, con la intencion de que le prometa que se casara con el. Todos sus pequenos amigos acuden a rescatarla y Papa Pitufo consigue ponerle los zapatos magicos al duende, obligandole a bailar hasta que se hace de noche.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Natural y Travieso roban la formula de Gargamel para hacer otro Pitufo - otra pitufa para acompanar a Pitufina. Asi pues, crean a Sassette, que crea problemas por doquier. Haciendo uso de su pocion, Papa Pitufo convierte la malvada creacion de Gargamel en una simpatica Sassette.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filosofo invita a todos los Pitufos a su fiesta, pero les va echando uno por uno cuando no se divierten exactamente de la forma que el les indica. Entonces, todos los expulsados celebran su propia fiesta y son lo bastante magnanimos como para permitir que Pitufo Filosofo se una a ellos.

programme.title: La Pitufivision De Genio
programme.desc: Pitufo Minero rebusca bajo todas las piedras y, gracias a ello, descubre un cristal que transmite imagenes. Esto permite a Pitufo Carpintero inventar la pitufivision y, desde ese momento, los Pitufos pueden ver todas las mananas los entrenamientos de Pitufo Fortachon, los informes de las cosechas de Pitufo Labrador e incluso el programa de Pitufo Filosofo. Pero ¿quien podria haberlo imaginado? ¡El malvado mago Gargamel se aprovecha de la pitufivision para atrapar Pitufos!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Carpintero ha salvado a Pitufo Torpe de un terrible destino. Pitufo Torpe jura devocion eterna a su salvador y se esfuerza al maximo por saldar su deuda... con consecuencias desastrosas. Se hace necesario idear un plan ingenioso para evitar las bienintencionadas catastrofes causadas por Pitufo Torpe...

programme.title: El Libro De Bromas De Bromista
programme.desc: Las cajas sorpresa de Pitufo Bromista ya no resultan divertidas para los demas Pitufos. Pitufo Bromista busca nuevas ideas en su «Gran libro de las bromas», pero esas ideas son aun peor recibidas en la aldea. Y entonces, Gargamel llega con algunas bromas de su propia cosecha...

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¿Que es esa extrana rana parlante que ha hecho que el hechicero Morlock haya enviado a todos los soldados del principe Teodoro para capturarla? ¿Es una rana demonio, como el dice? ¿O quiza lo hace por otro motivo? La verdad se desvelara cuando Pitufina y los Pitufitos se encuentran con la rana. Ayudan a la rana a volver a transformarse en el principe Teodoro, que habia sido victima de un hechizo lanzado por Morlock.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos aman las trufas y las trufas son de los Trolls. No sera nada facil que los suspiritos azules tengan un banquete.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cuando el hada de las flores aparece en el pueblo de los Pitufos, todos se enamoran de su encanto e inteligencia. Y pronto se daran cuenta de que se convertira en una especie de mama pitufo para todos...

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel esta decidido a sobrevolar la Aldea Pitufa para atrapar a un Pitufo y llevarlo a la Convencion de los Magos, e invoca a su libro de hechizos para que le ayude. Esto da lugar a una serie de divertidos contratiempos con su maquina voladora, y Gargamel vuelve a convertirse en el hazmerreir de la Convencion de los Magos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Todos sabemos que Pitufo Grunon odia varias cosas. Pero la cosa que odia mas que nada es el agua, cuando hay suficiente de esta para que se pueda ahogar. Veras, Pitufo Grunon no sabe nadar. Y cuando los Pitufos notan esta peculiaridad y le tratan de ensenar como sobrevivir en el agua, el malvado mago Gargamel hace que todo sea un poco mas peligroso de lo que deberia ser...

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: En su plan por librarse de los Pitufos, Gargamel le lanza un hechizo a Giganton y se disfraza de Pitufo. Creyendo que es un Pitufo, Giganton esta a punto de destrozar por completo la Aldea Pitufa hasta que Papa Pitufo acude con una cura.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Ahora Los Pitufeas Y Ahora No
programme.desc: Los troles subterraneos capturan a los Pitufos para que sean sus esclavos. Papa Pitufo ingeniosamente los libera y luego destruye la bola de cristal magica que les concede el poder sobre los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Viaje Al Pitufo De La Tierra
programme.desc: El invierno ha llegado a la Aldea Pitufa. Y los pequenos Pitufos estan helados de frio. ¿Pero que esta haciendo Pitufo Torpe con esa extrana roca que ha descubierto? ¿Y por que esta tan entusiasmado Pitufo Minero con su nuevo descubrimiento? Nadie entiende a que se debe tanto revuelo por una simple nueva roca para la coleccion de Pitufo Torpe... Al adentrarse bajo tierra, los Pitufos encontraran peligros y sorpresas.

programme.title: La Amiga De Pitufina
programme.desc: Pitufina ha encontrado a una nueva amiga, Laura, una nina de seis anos de edad cuyos padres viven cerca del bosque. Juntas, las dos ninas se pasean por el bosque. Pero una vieja bruja que vive en el bosque las captura.

programme.title: Sassette Aprende A Leer
programme.desc: Pitufo Filosofo esta horrorizado. Sasita no sabe leer, por lo que podria estar condenada a perderse las perlas de sabiduria que contiene su libro «Citas de Pitufo Filosofo». Asi pues, intenta ensenarla a leer. Sin embargo, resulta que casi lo primero que puede leer es una formula para hacer que todos los libros desaparezcan. Todos los libros del mundo, ¡incluidos el libro de hechizos de Gargamel y los libros de remedios de Omnibus!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Todo Lo Que Brilla No Es Pitufo
programme.desc: Gargamel captura a diez Pitufos para su pocima de oro y Papa Pitufo planea su rescate. Consigue atraer al malvado mago hasta el bosque con una montana de oro falso mientras utiliza al inconsciente gato para liberar a los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Durante una mision para interrumpir la fiesta de Halloween de los pitufos, Gargamel y Hogatha consiguen capturar a Perezoso, el cual se ha vuelto rojo por un extrano capricho de la naturaleza. Papa pitufo y los demas conseguiran liberar a Perezoso, y la Madre Naturaleza devolvera su color al pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cuando se produce una emergencia, todos los Pitufos de la aldea dejan lo que tienen entre manos y corren a oir las noticias. Pero que Pitufo Vanidoso convoque una asamblea para que los Pitufos puedan admirar su nuevo gorro es pasarse de la raya. Le echan de la aldea y Pitufo Vanidoso tiene la mala suerte de encontrarse con Lofty, el elfo, que le recomienda darse un horrible bano de fango...

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren una Fuente de la Juventud cuidada por un espantoso Troll que roba el libro magico de Papa Pitufo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Carpintero ha ideado un nuevo invento: el pitufimovil. Todos los Pitufos tienen su propio vehiculo personalizado y todos (o casi todos) disfrutan dando una vuelta en ellos. Sin embargo, el malvado mago Gargamel se aprovecha de la idea y empieza a causar problemas a los Pitufos...

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Tontin lleva una Rebotilla al pueblo, donde la pequena y adorable criatura se multiplicara y amenazara con comerse la nueva presa. Pitufo Armonia toca una cancion y las Rebotillas encandiladas le siguen en fila india hasta el bosque donde se juntaran a Gargamel.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Brenda, la pequena bruja, se siente rechazada: nadie la quiere llevar al Baile de las Escobas de este ano. Ay, si pudiera encontrar a algun chico guapo... Entonces conoce a Escrupuloso, el aprendiz del malvado mago Gargamel. Es muy apuesto, ¡y esta libre! Lo que ella no sabe es que Escrupuloso solamente esta interesado en su varita magica. Y lo que saben los Pitufos es que la van a ayudar a salir del aprieto.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado mago Gargamel ha conseguido unos huevos magicos de cristal ectoplasmico que le permitiran intercambiar su cuerpo con el de Papa Pitufo. ¿Que otro plan mejor que ese podria haber? Una vez que este en el cuerpo de Papa Pitufo, llevara a todos los Pitufos hasta su caldero. Pero, por una jugarreta del destino, Gargamel se transforma en Puppy, el perro de los Pitufos...

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El invierno ha llegado y los Pitufos estan a punto de sucumbir al intenso frio. ¿Podra Pitufo Rastreador encontrar el remedio sin caer en las garras de Gargamel?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Patoso y sus desventuras le llevan a traves de un rio a un lugar desconocido. Alli conoce a las duendecillas, unas adorables criaturitas cuyos enemigos acabaran encontrandose con los Pitufos.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Pitufo Marco Y Los Piratas Pimienta
programme.desc: Los Pitufos navegan para salvar a Marco, que ha sido capturado por el Capitan Pedro Pimienta. Marina y un delfin acaban liberando a Marco.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Nadie cree a Abuelo Pitufo cuando habla de junglas y sabanas lejanas, repletas de gatos salvajes gigantes, caballos a rayas, comedores de hojas de cuello largo y extranas tribus... Tan solo algunos Pitufitos dan cierto credito a sus historias. Pero, cuando Abuelo Pitufo escucha en el bosque el sonido del tambor real magico, un instrumento capaz de domar bestias salvajes, se lanza a la aventura para demostrar que no es un contador de historias al que el cerebro le juega malas pasadas.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Fortachon se disfraza de Pitufina para atraer a Piltkin, el gnomo que se ha enamorado de ella, y alejarlo de la Aldea Pitufa. Excavan bajo tierra y conocen a una gnoma que se enamora de Piltkin, quien se olvida de Pitufina y pasa a tener ojos solo para su nueva conquista.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Filosofo se siente preparado para la ocasion cuando empieza a preparar una receta de galletas. Esta convencido de que va a ganar el concurso, ya que ha tomado prestada una receta del libro de magia de Papa Pitufo. Sin embargo, una gran sorpresa y algunas situaciones desagradables aguardan al pobre Pitufo Filosofo y a toda la aldea.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Giganton roba el suministro de alimentos de invierno y de los Pitufos y Pitufo Filosofo prepara una de las pociones de fortaleza de Papa Pitufo para que pueda luchar contra el codicioso gigante. La super formula desaparece, pero Papa Pitufo hace un cambio rapido, cambia la comida por piedras y Giganton sale perdiendo.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¿Recuerdas al ogro Giganton y a su encantadora esposa Narizota? Ahora tienen un bebe: el pequeno (segun los estandares de los ogros) Pies Grandes. Como a los Pitufitos no les permiten cuidar de Bebe Pitufo, Pitufo Colerico, Pitufo Blandengue, Pitufo Natural y la siempre dispuesta Sasita se ofrecen a vigilar a Pies Grandes mientras sus padres estan en el baile de los ogros. Los Pitufitos conseguiran mas de lo que esperaban...

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Te despiertas temprano por la manana, antes de que los demas Pitufos se hayan levantado de sus camas, para preparar sabrosos bizcochos de pitufrutas. Dedicas toda la manana a preparar pitufimanjares para el almuerzo. Despues, toda la tarde a tener la deliciosa cena lista a tiempo. ¿Y acaso los demas Pitufos te dan siquiera las gracias? Asi pues, Pitufo Goloso dimite. La aldea esta en problemas... y pronto, tambien lo esta Pitufo Goloso.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El malvado brujo Gargamel pide al mago Balthazar una receta para capturar a los pitufos. Implica secuestrar a la Madre Naturaleza para impedir la llegada de la Primavera. Por suerte, los pitufos salvan la situacion.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos llevan a Abuelo Pitufo al castillo del rey para que pueda conocer a Guillermo. Pero, entre una cosa y otra (sobre todo otra), los Pitufos y Guillermo acaban a bordo de una gran nave vikinga. Los vikingos creen que Guillermo es su mitico gran guerrero, aquel que derrotara al Rey Tormenta. ¿Podran los Pitufos ayudar a Guillermo a salir de este embrollo?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hogata consigue los pendientes dorados magicos de Sonoria, que le permitiran oir las voces de los Pitufos desde lejos. Siguiendo los ronquidos de Pitufo Perezoso, esta a punto de llegar hasta la Aldea Pitufa, pero entonces los sonidos del cuerno de Pitufo Armonia comienzan a resonar en sus pendientes y huye enfurecida de vuelta a casa.

programme.title: La Merienda Del Pitufo Goloso
programme.desc: Esta vez, Gargamel se siente seguro de si mismo. Bueno, casi... ¡Esta a punto de atrapar a los pequenos Pitufos! Las ligerisimas tortitas de Pitufo Goloso casi provocan que los Pitufos floten hasta quedar al alcance de Gargamel.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Indeciso, tal como su nombre indica, no consigue decidirse sobre nada. Los otros Pitufos le llevan al bosque para hacer una prueba de supervivencia en la que unicamente pueda encontrar el camino de vuelta a casa tomando decisiones. Sin embargo, acaba en el castillo de Baltasar.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: En la Aldea Pitufo hay un ataque de Mala Suerte y cien Pitufos deben bailar una danza magica para recuperar la buena fortuna, ¡pero solo hay 99 en la aldea! ¿Quien sera el centesimo Pitufo?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Una Fiesta De Pijamas Para Perezoso
programme.desc: ¡Pobre Pitufo Perezoso! Todo lo que desea es una buena noche de descanso. Pero no: todos los Pitufos celebran una fiesta en su honor y, lo que es peor, se ve arrastrado a una absurda discusion sobre pintar los dedos de los pies de Giganton de un brillante color mandarina. ¡Va a ser una larga noche en vela para el pobre Pitufo Perezoso!

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren la supersticion cuando Pitufo Torpe rompe el espejo de Pitufo Vanidoso antes de una lluvia de meteoritos. Un meteorito cae sobre la casa de Pitufo Torpe y todos lo atribuyen a la mala suerte. Sin embargo, se dan cuenta de lo descabellado de ese pensamiento cuando comprueban que Pitufo Torpe no estaba dentro de casa en ese momento.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Nadie escucha nunca los consejos de Pitufo Filosofo, asi que, cuando Papa Pitufo marcha de viaje y Pitufo Filosofo cree estar al mando, decide que va a ser el quien tenga todas las respuestas. El libro de hechizos de Papa Pitufo contiene una formula magica para garantizar que todos los habitantes de la Aldea Pitufa acudan a Pitufo Filosofo para pedirle su opinion. Y, por si las cosas no fueran lo suficientemente complicadas, aqui llega Gargamel...

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Cuando una gota de la nueva pocion de Papa Pitufo cae en el libro de aventuras de los Pitufitos, el heroe de ficcion cobra vida. El intrepido Don Pitufo, que desea deshacer a los Pitufos del malvado Gargamel, lo captura con valentia...

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Hay algun tipo de poder maligno en la corona del Titan que Minero encuentra bajo tierra, y Avaricioso acaba sucumbiendo a el. Cuando Gargamel aparece con una de sus fechorias en mente, todo se acaba enrevesandose.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos descubren el espiritu deportivo, la alegria y la amista cuando llevan a cabo sus primeros "Juegos Pitufos". Los Pitufos deciden ponerse en forma tras casi perder contra el gato Azrael.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos van al rescate de dos ninos y su abuelo, cuando un misterioso extranjero aparece haciendo que su trineo se rompa en pedazos. Al llamar a la puerta de Gargamel en busca de ayuda, no se dan cuenta de que estan poniendo en peligro sus vidas y la de los Pitufos...

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Gargamel infecta de odio el corazon de Pitufo Fortachon y, a continuacion, usa al pequeno Pitufo como senuelo para los demas. Afortunadamente, el amor de Pitufo Fortachon vence al odio y ayuda a sus pequenos amigos a escapar de las garras de Gargamel.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Cosas Que Putifan En La Noche
programme.desc: Cuando Pitufo Colerico pierde a su oso de peluche Huggy, no consigue dormir a pesar de los esfuerzos de Papa Pitufo por convencerle de que los osos de peluche son magicos y pueden cuidar de si mismos. Gargamel se tropieza con la Aldea Pitufa y Huggy regresa convertido en un oso gigante para espantar y salvar a Pitufo Colerico.

programme.title: El Ultimo Hechizo De Papa Pitufo
programme.desc: Papa Pitufo ha sido elegido Hechicero del Ano, y el malvado mago Gargamel esta verde de envidia. Buscara la forma de hacer que los poderes de Papa Pitufo desaparezcan. Entonces, podra atrapar a todos los Pitufos y celebrarlo con un gran banquete... Ahora bien, ¿permitira Papa Pitufo que suceda algo tan terrible? Por supuesto que no: Papa Pitufo encontrara la forma de arruinar el plan de Gargamel...

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Se ha desatado una guerra en la Edad Media. Unos caballeros vestidos con armadura destrozan por accidente la Aldea Pitufa, lo que provoca que una pequena banda de Pitufos decida vengar esta afrenta. ¿No pensara Papa Pitufo que esta es una accion demasiado propia de los humanos?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.sub-title: Una Choza No Es Un Hogar
programme.desc: Gargamel desea tener una choza mas grande, y recurre al Gran libro de hechizos para conjurar un nuevo hogar. Sin embargo, todos sus hechizos le salen del reves y esto le convence de que no hay ningun sitio como el hogar.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El chico del bosque y Laconia, la elfa muda y sorda, preguntan a Papa Pitufo que celebre su boda. Mientras los Pitufos preparan la fiesta bajo las ordenes de Pitufina, Gargamel hace acto de presencia.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Los Pitufos se preparan para recuperar una concha marina que necesitan para liberar a un ermitano de las garras de la Bruja del Mar, la cual le maldijo con un aspecto horrible y un lenguaje dificil de entender. Los Pitufos consiguen recuperar la concha a tiempo para romper el maleficio y devolver al ermitano a su verdadero ser.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La produccion teatral de los Pitufos "Pitufo Robin" se convierte en realidad con un actor real del legendario heroe.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: El mago malvado Gargamel ha elaborado otro plan diabolico con la ayuda de su madre, quien no es mas agradable que el. El quiere persuadir a los Pitufos con dinero pero ellos no saben lo que les espera. ¿Pitufo Goloso caera en la trampa?

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La mosca morada muerde a Pitufo Perezoso, provocando una epidemia en el pueblo que les convertira a todos en furiosos Pitufos morados. Papa Pitufo descubre que el polen de una flor del bosque es el antidoto y pronto las cosas volveran a pitufar como siempre.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: Pitufo Labrador se pregunta que hace una calabaza en el melonar, cuando deberia estar junto a los colinabos. Cuando Pitufo Labrador tira de la calabaza y la separa del suelo, libera a un genio que comienza a llamarle amo e insiste en concederle deseos. El ansia del genio, llamado Gourdy, por complacer a Pitufo Labrador hara que, mas que en una ayuda, se convierta en una molestia.

programme.title: Me and my Robot
programme.desc: Eugene is a robotic genius, who has built his own robot called C.H.I.P. Together, along with Eugene’s best friends from high-tech robotic school, they get into misadventure when relying on their ingenuity (or sometimes lack of it) to try and resolve an issue that arises over the course of their daily school life.

programme.title: Paper Port
programme.desc: Paper Port

programme.title: Los Pitufos - Spanish
programme.desc: Pitufo Genio inventa a Pituforobotín para que ayude a todos los Pitufos en sus labores, pero Filósofo lo reprograma para que abandone la Aldea Pitufo.

programme.title: Van Dogh - Spanish
programme.desc: Yon, Pan y Kit se encuentran a Van Dogh pintando entre girasoles. Pero en el lienzo de este genial perro pintor, surgen mágicos rompecabezas. Enigmas visuales que los tres niños intentarán resolver, convirtiendo esas adivinanzas en un juego apasionante.

programme.title: The Smurfs - Chinese
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Chinese

programme.title: Rainbow Chicks - Chinese
programme.desc: Rainbow Chicks - Chinese

programme.title: The Smurfs - Arabic
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Arabic

programme.title: Mouk
programme.desc: Mouk and Chavapa, are two globe-trotting friends who explore the World on their bikes. From Hong-Kong to New York, from Brazil to Madagascar and Chile, they discover our modern world and its colorful inhabitants.

programme.title: Ria Rabbit
programme.desc: Ria Rabbit is about a cute little rabbit who stays in Pashu Nagri and loves to have fun with her family and friends.

programme.title: Bigi & Friends
programme.desc: Bigi is a little blue hippopotamus with a big heart. programme.sub-title: The Nature of Reality: Dreaming Reality

programme.sub-title: Vinyasa for Life: From Cobra to Camel
programme.desc: This vinyasa class applies what you learned in Day 1 so you can play with classic backbends and steady transitions. Schuyler guides you through Cobra (Bhujangasana), Locust (Salabhasana), and Camel (Ustrasana), finishing off with Bridge (Setu Bandhasana) and spine-clearing twists. Take it slow and build strength!

programme.title: Ma Cherie TV Season 1 Episode 9
programme.desc: In this episode, Cherie will take us on a journey of life—in particular, about the journey of one women’s life named Emily. We will travel through time of Emily’s life and as we observe Emily’s journey we may ask: what does the word time mean to you? How do you spend your time, and are you satisfied with the time that has passed thus far in your life? Do you ever wish that you could go back in time, or fast forward time? As we watch this episode, Cherie helps us to reflect on our own life and it helps us think how time is a precious gift that should not be wasted.

programme.title: The Ring Thing
programme.desc: When Sarah accidentally proposes to her girlfriend in Provincetown, she finds herself at odds with her partner's expectations of their future. The mixup sends both women on different journeys of marital exploration. Sarah, a documentary filmmaker, begins interviewing same-sex couples in an attempt to overcome her fear of divorce. Kristen, who's ready to tie the knot, sees a future version of her life with Sarah where career and passion threaten to pull the women apart.

programme.title: Stronger
programme.desc: Andy is a successful and handsome openly gay actor. He is leading the perfect life, married to a big shot Hollywood executive and raising two small children. Will this world of external beauty hold up when he encounters a former colleague in a West Hollywood bar on Christmas Eve. In the psychological wrestling match that follows only the strongest can win. But who is stronger? The film is based on a classic play by August Strindberg, but updated to a contemporary setting with gay characters.

programme.title: A Matter of Prejudice
programme.desc: A Matter of Prejudice takes a modern twist on an 1893 short story by Kate Chopin and explores the beauty of love and acceptance when an aging woman finally overcomes her prejudice. Our hero is a French-speaking African immigrant named Madame Carambeau, aka Madame C. Because of her religious beliefs and fears, she hasn't spoken to her gay son in seven years even though it pains her. Her mindset begins to change after a chance encounter with a sick little girl during her grandson’s seventh birthday party. Relevant in today’s society and sensitive to the struggles of the LGBTQ community, this story shows what can happen when we simply open our hearts.

programme.title: Stomping Grounds
programme.sub-title: "St. Johns "River Rats" - Boatgating in Jacksonville's 1st Coast"
programme.desc: Come along with Stomping Grounds host Ryan McVinney and the Boat Trader crew as they embark on an exciting journey to the First Coast Region of Northeast Florida and discover a flourishing boating culture. Explore the beauty of Jacksonville, a city built along the banks of the St. Johns River, with its rich history and vibrant waterfront culture. Discover the highly productive ecosystem, abundant wildlife and the only known calving grounds for the North Atlantic right whale. Experience the excitement of "boatgating", a uniquely American tradition held on the river at the Jacksonville Jaguars home stadium along with a group of recreational boaters known as the "River Rats". Go fishing with NFL player Logan Cooke on his 26-foot Yellowfin center console boat and cruising with local personality Lisa "The Boatanista" Almeida on her family cabin cruiser. Witness the precision and power of naval aviation with the Blue Angels flight squadron. Learn about the country's largest and oldest boat club, Freedom Boat Club, offering members access to the beautiful waters of the Intracoastal Waterway, St. John's River, and Atlantic Ocean. Boating is more than just a pastime here—it's a way of life. Don't miss this unforgettable episode!

"I wish we would get to a point where we really put our foot down and do something about it before it's too late." - Watch this episode to learn more about what's going on and to see why Capt. programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to Ukraine and the wonderful capital city of Kyiv. Were here for the second time for the iconic truck pull World Championships! The reigning World champion Kelvin de Ruiter from Holland will defend his title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this episode, a final chance for our athletes to get vital world series ranking points on board to give them the best possible chance of success and an initial advantage at the finals. It's the last show before the world finals and the top 10 places are up for grabs, but who will they be?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in Alanya, on Turkeys south-coast for the final stop at the end of a mammoth season. Here in the sunshine, well finally crown our world champion and what a place Alanya is - you could not ask for a better setting. Aivars Smaukstellis, the reigning world champion is defending his title, and two-time world champion Dainis Zageris is also here, but with a though competition, who will win?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: What a day ahead of us here in Alanya, just a handful of events to go before we find out who will be the winner of Strongman Champions League in 2021. These are the world finals, and all the big names are in the house. With just 3 events to go - who will take the crown of World Champion 2021 and be the STRONGEST?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Across seven rivers, through mountains and forests, 12 strongmen go to toughest places to find out who is strongest Viking in the World and open a new season of Strongman champions league for 2015. Events like the Hercules Hold, Yoke Race and pulling a real Viking ship are some of the ingredients of this fantastic show.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The second stage of Strongman champions league will be hosted in Germany, by FIBO - the leading international trade show for fitness, wellness and health worldwide with 300,000 visitors in four days. Special implements like the biggest log in the world or the special Bavarian stone lift are not only a challenge, but also an opportunity for new personal, national and world records.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Holland is hosting 12 different countries with 14 of the strongest men in the world for the third stage of the Strongman Champions League.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Zydrunas Savickas, one of strongest people on earth is in this competition which has attracted the attention of the audience in the battle for the title of strongest man in Finland. The next round of SCL is in Bulgaria.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next stage of the competition is in Bulgaria where Ervin Katona (SCL World Champion 2012) will compete for the last time.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Krzysztof Radzikowski, the leader in the league will fight hard to keep Dainis Zageris off from the title and to gather another 25 ranking points in this next stage in Latvia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The competition sees a close battle with a new world record in overhead dumbbell and close finishes throughout the day. This stage is in Croatia, in a city over 1700 years old, steeped in Roman tradition and history, the athletes arrive for the truck pull after a picturesque boat ride on the Adriatic Sea.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are now half way through the SCL 2015 and getting closer to the grand world finals in Turkey. The eighth stage is in Poland, the home country of the current leader Krzysztof Radzikowski.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this stage we go into the mountains of Austria to find out through six grueling events who is the strongest in the land of Alps. Martin Wildauer, current World Champion 2014 and Austrian local is competing alongside Zageris, Radzikowski, Belsak and many others.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The 10th stage of this year's competition in Strongman Champions League is held in the Romanian city of Sibiu where the 12 strongmen continue to compete for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 11, World Log Lift Championship
programme.desc: The 11th stage is the SCL Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. In this championship, each competitor must lift three different weights overhead. Zydrunas Savickas is the current world record holder in the Log Lift.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This next episode of the Strongman Champions League is hosted in Lithuania and sees us getting one step closer to the final.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The 13th stage of Strongman Champions League is in Maia, Portugal. The competition is at the “Powerexpo” – one of the best sport and fitness events in Portugal.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This stage is in Martinique and eight strongmen from all over the world will compete for the last chance to gather points before the world grand finals in December.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 15, Lightweight World Championship
programme.desc: A special World championship under the newcomers and lightweights in the Strongman world. Some of them will step from this to the heavyweights divisions.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.sub-title: SCL 2015 Season 2, Episode 16, World Finals Turkey
programme.desc: After 15 outstanding competitions all over the world, finally we are here at the final competition of this year’s Strongman Champions League hosted in Turkey.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in beautiful Norway for the kick off of the 2017 MLO Strongman Champions League season. With partly cloudy weather and lots of snow, we have the perfect scenery for the athletes, who prepare for the first contest of the year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A definite highlight in this FIBO edition in Germany, Strongman Champions League introduced its new rules for a special team item. Graham Hicks tries here to set a New World Record on the biggest log in the world, currently held by Krzysztof Radzikowski. Boosted also by the presence of the acclaimed in the strongman circles names of Mark Felix and Danis Zageris.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This weekend sees the Strongman Champions League Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. Big lifting names such as Graham Hicks , Vidas Blekaitis and Vytatus Lalas are in the startlist to push some big numbers.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The battle of the Dutch will take place this edition in Lichtenvoorde, a place very well known in Holland because of the famous “Black Cross”. The athletes will compete over six heavy events and the winner gets 25 Strongman Champions League ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Set in the beautiful mountain resort Zlatibor, the fifth stage of the Strongman Champions League 2017 sees 14 athletes from across the world competing for the gold medal of SCL Serbia 2017. The event welcomes top-athlete - and odds-on favourite - Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia), who has presented himself in an impressive shape so far. Can his opponents defeat him?

programme.sub-title: Episode 0 - The Last Road Race in the World
programme.desc: Drivers talk about the ultimate road race, La Carrera Panamericana. A seven-day, 2,000-mile vintage rally race across México. For 34 years, teams from around the world have come to test themselves in this one-of-a-kind race. This series brings together some of the most successful and experienced teams, to talk about how the race works, the challenges racers face, and why they come back year after year to rally through the beauty of México.

programme.title: Driving La Carrera
programme.sub-title: Episode - 3 The Spirit of México With Hilaire and Laura Damiron
programme.desc: Hilaire and Laura Damiron began racing La Carrera in 2009. In 2016 they won the race and have been fighting for the overall win every year since. programme.title: Gearing Up
programme.sub-title: Gearing Up: Episode 3 - Motorcross, Monster Jam, Rally Jameel
programme.desc: March’s episode of Gearing Up is packed with excitement and high-speed action from some of the world's most thrilling motorsports events. First up, viewers are taken on a wild ride to the Night of the Jumps in Berlin. The event features some of the world's most talented freestyle motocross riders pushing the limits and achieving great stunts. Next stop, Monster Jam. As one of the most popular monster truck shows in the world, Monster Jam is known for its massive trucks, impressive stunts, and thrilling races. But behind the scenes, a team of experts works together to ensure that everything runs smoothly. Gearing Up explores and brings to light the essential teamwork and communication required to bring success to the whole organization. We then completely switch terrains and move to Africa, for the Africa ECO Race. This grueling off-road rally spans over 6,500 kilometers and takes competitors through some of the most challenging terrains on the planet. From the deserts of Morocco to the beaches of Senegal, the Africa ECO Race is an adventure like no other. Finally, Gearing Up gives viewers a sneak peek about what is about to follow in the next episode, which will focus on the exciting world of Rally Jameel in Saudi Arabia. The first navigation off-road rally for women in Saudi Arabia and the region, focused on testing participants' navigation and driving skills. Drivers can cover up to 300 and 500 kilometers per day, through some of Saudi Arabia's most beautiful heritage sites. Join Gearing Up for a high-speed adventure as it explores some of the most thrilling motorsports events from around the world. From freestyle motocross to monster trucks and off-road rallies, Gearing Up has it all

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Avalanche danger is very high in the Rogers Pass area of the Trans Canada Highway in British Columbia. Host of Angry Planet George Kourounis travels with a variety of experts to bring down huge avalanches in the Rocky Mountains. Ski Patrollers throw hand charges to clear the slopes, the British Columbia Department of Highways uses helicopter bombing and mountaintop mortars to keep the roads safe, and the Canadian Armed Forces fire 105mm howitzers at the mountains to bring down the dangerous snow. Still, there are accidents and fatalities in the mountains. We meet Francois Desroisers, an avalanche burial victim who tells a terrible and tragic tale of a mountain disaster.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Mount Washington, New Hampshire has the dubious title of being home to the worlds worst weather. The highest wind ever recorded on the planet 231 miles per hour was recorded at its mountaintop observatory. To prepare for a mid-winter assault on the summit, Angry Planet host George Kourounis becomes a human popsicle, encased in ice in at the National Resarch Councils high speed wind tunnel. Then he and his sidekick Mark Robinson climb to the top of the mountain in mid-January and brave their way into a summit blizzard.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Some of the fiercest weather on the planet can be experienced at the southern tip of Argentina and Chile the area the South Americans call the Fin del Mundo the end of the world. Host George Kourounis travels to Ushuaia, Argentina, sails south on the expedition sailboat Northanger to round infamous Cape Horn, then climbs the spectacular but rapidly melting glaciers along the Beagle Channel.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Dominica, the most volcanic and mountainous island in the Caribbean, is home to the Boiling Lake, a large waterfall-fed lake of furiously boiling water. Adventurer George Kourounis becomes the first person ever to traverse across the lake on a rope, risking his life to take water samples and shoot video from a place no human has ever been. He then dives to the ocean floor off the coast of the island to explore vents where the superheated water bubbles into the ocean.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: George Kourounis returns to Tornado Alley with three of his fellow stormchasers to see what the 2007 Storm Season will bring. He gets a birthday gift of a large Kansas tornado, then travels to Missouri to witness a string of violent thunderstorms. programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: Eating on the Edge of Nowhere
programme.desc: Cambodia and Japan: Taking his obsession with the film Apocalypse Now a little too seriously, Tony sets out for Pailin, reputed to be one of the most dangerous towns on earth. After his journey, Tony returns to Japan.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Portugal: Portuguese cuisine holds a dear place in Tony's culinary heart. Tony travels to Porto, home of the famous Port wine, where he is immediately exposed to the codfish and the almost mythical place it holds in Portuguese cuisine and culture.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: San Sebastian: A Food Lover's Town
programme.desc: San Sebastian, Spain: Tony explores the food-crazed Basque culture. Tony's guide, Chef Luis Irizar, takes Tony into the underworld of Basque gastronomic societies. Later, Tony explores the city's tapas bars.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Arcachon, France: Here, Bourdain first learned to love food as a child. Returning for a trip down memory lane, Tony enjoys childhood staples, including steak frites, gaufres (waffles), soupe de pecheur (fisherman's soup) and fresh oysters.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Portugal & Southwest France: Visiting his boss's family farm, Tony helps slaughter and feast on a pig the family has been fattening all year. Then, Tony heads to France to experience the rich delights of a foie gras farm.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Morocco (Sahara): Tony traverses the Moroccan desert with one goal in mind, to eat a mud-oven-roasted sheep.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Morocco (Cities): Tony is invited to experience the culinary heart and distinct walled medinas (districts) of the Moroccan city Fes.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: The Cook Who Came in From the Cold
programme.desc: St. Petersburg, Russia: Tony plays spy in Russia and sets off to locate the best blinis and borscht St. Petersburg has to offer.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: So Much Vodka, So Little Time
programme.desc: St. Petersburg, Russia: Tony continues his mission with a tour of local working-class specialties. He tries his hand at ice-fishing, drinks a lot of vodka, feasts on Russian foods, eats smoked fish and ends the outing with a dip in the outdoor cold pool.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Oaxaca, Mexico: Chef Tony Bourdain explores the exotic and colorful indigenous zone of Mexico's Oaxaca region where he tastes toasted grasshoppers and other delicacies. His adventure ends with mariachi music and, of course, lots of tequila.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: Puebla, Where the Good Cooks Are From
programme.desc: Puebla, Mexico: According to Tony, the best line cooks in NYC come from Mexico, so he travels to the Puebla, and enjoys mole sauces, toasted ant eggs, fried worms, and the legendary pulque (a slightly hallucinogenic drink made from cactus sap).

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: Los Angeles, My Own Heart of Darkness
programme.desc: Los Angeles, CA: New York chef, Anthony Bourdain, descends into the culinary underbelly of his metropolitan nemesis, Los Angeles, where he experiences the trials of celebrity fame and the joys of West Coast cuisine.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Napa, CA: Marooned in San Francisco, Tony tastes local shellfish and durian ice cream before embarking on a pilgrimage to experience the genius of Thomas Keller, chef and owner of The French Laundry.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: New York, NY: Passionate about his city, Tony gives us an intimate tour of the New York City foods he loves - sturgeon and bagels, fluke ceviche, pan-seared foie gras, braised veal cheek, authentic cheese and, of course, a hotdog.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: New York, NY and Provincetown, MA: Experience the formative moments of Tony's career as he revisits his first job, the culinary institute that taught him the basics, a normal workday at Les Halles Brasserie, and his mysterious mentor, Bigfoot.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Scotland: Beginning in Glasgow, Tony experiences the heart-clogging glory of deep fried pizza, deep fried mars bars, and deep fried pickled eggs! Moving on to more traditional fare, Tony tastes haggis and learns to hunt and fish for his food.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour

programme.title: Devo Live In The Land Of The Rising Sun Japan 2003
programme.desc: "From a stage super-heated by over-the-top, rock 'n roll cliche lighting, DEVO faced a sea of Asian Gen X'ers in a 100 degree plus fahrenheit venue in the bowels of Tokyo, Japan. The crowd was swathed in bootlegged energy domes and DEVO T's, mouthing the lyrics to songs we wrote when most of them were loading their diapers with UNi-colored poo. Maybe it was a "Beautiful World" after all!" - Gerry Casale. Track list: That's Good, Girl U Want, Whip It, Satisfaction, Uncontrollable Urge, Mongoloid, Blockhead, Jocko Homo, Smart Patrol/Mr. DNA, Gut Feeling/Slap Yer Mammy, Gates Of Steel, Freedom Of Choice, Come Back Jonee

programme.title: Europe Final Countdown Tour Live In Sweden
programme.desc: To celebrate the 20th anniversary of EUROPE's "The Final Countdown" album and tour, this 13-track live concert from Solnahallen in Stockholm 1986 has been remastered in Dolby Digital and restored in widescreen format. The DVD features interviews with the band from 2006, and an extensive gallery with never-before-seen photos from "The Final Countdown" tour. It also features the only existing unreleased outtake from "The Final Countdown" recording sessions: "Where Men Won't Dare", an instrumental written by Joey Tempest and John Leven. Additional bonuses include the band revisiting the Powerplay Studios where they recorded "The Final Countdown" album, and a detailed bio.
